news_headlines.title: Gartner Reports PC Shipment Growth Driven By Channel Inventory
news_headlines.summary: Gartner reports that worldwide PC shipments reached 62.8 million units in Q1 2026, marking a 4% year-over-year increase. This growth was primarily driven by vendors and channel distributors increasing inventory levels in anticipation of price hikes due to rising memory costs, rather than genuine consumer demand. Lenovo maintained its lead, while Apple saw significant growth, primarily due to strong demand for the MacBook Neo.

news_headlines.title: Gartner: Global PC Market Returns to Growth with 4% Increase in Q1 2026
news_headlines.summary: The global PC market saw a 4% increase in shipments during Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025, totaling 62.8 million units, according to Gartner. This growth was primarily driven by vendors and distributors increasing inventory due to anticipated price hikes from memory inflation and component costs, rather than genuine demand. Apple experienced the largest jump in market share among major vendors, largely due to strong demand for the MacBook Neo in educational and cost-conscious segments.
